intro_html: The Dos d'Âne (back of a donkey) is likely the most attractive itinerary to the popular Creux du Van: an entertaining hike with scrambling passages.

routes.notes_html: The hike is an entertaining itinerary on a ridge and through the forest with several scrambling passages. The T4 degree is for the lower part in the steep forest (fairly difficult orientation, tiresome terrain) and the upper, rocky part (easy scrambling passages). If the terrain is dry, the whole tour does not necessarily require hiking boots. Sturdy sneakers will do.
